behavior.unbound: render bundled representative destination metadata keyed to the supplied SVG
behavior.boundEmpty: render the configured empty state without restoring bundled rows
behavior.invalidRows: skip rows whose id or name is missing
behavior.ordering: sort by category and destination name while preserving the SVG id as the routing key
behavior.routeable: false marks destinations shown on the reference map but outside its walking-route graph
behavior.details: floor, hours, status, and keywords enrich the selected destination panel without changing SVG geometry
